Meta Test Description: This test case performs register write/read verification on 434 registers across the DWC Ethernet QoS IP (ethernet1). The test has two phases: (1) Default value check (chk_rst_val): reads each register and compares against its expected default value from default_value_array, using read_mask_array and skip_rst_array to control which registers are checked. (2) Write/Read check (chk_rd_wr): iterates over 6 data patterns (0xffffffff, 0xaaaaaaaa, 0x55555555, 0x00000000, 0xA5A5A5A5, 0xffff0000), writes each pattern to all writable registers, then reads back and compares against expected values computed using write_mask_array, read_mask_array, and default_value_array. Registers can be skipped via skip_array. A soft_reset_chk function is defined but commented out in the test_case flow. The test calls finish(1) on any failure (def_fail_cnt > 0 or wr_fail_cnt > 0) and finish(0) on success.
